items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: and a couple with Cedar Walton and Curtis Fuller and the all-star group with Lou Hayes on drums, I made a few gigs with them.

ctx.x: Here comes Jackson back and we did another ten years. Now we’re together. On many occasions now that’s the only jobs I’m taking outside of two individual jobs that I had, the one with John Lewis at Lincoln Center and a couple with Cedar Walton and Curtis Fuller and the all-star group with Lou Hayes on drums, I made a few gigs with them. Otherwise, I’m doing something out here in Montauk with Hal McKusick a couple of times a year and more local. With this organization that I’m the president of, the Montauk…
You’re being very modest, but this is the first Montauk Jazz Festival and there’s a tribute to you.
